proposed_widenings.name: dice_expr_ability_modifier_addend
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core reduction amount is a rolled value plus a specific ability modifier, but DiceAmount/DiceExpr cannot express non-spell ability-modifier addends.
proposed_widenings.evidence: reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier

proposed_widenings.name: equipment_predicate_free_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction is only available when the wearer has a free hand, and EquipmentPredicate has no way to encode that gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if you have a free hand

proposed_widenings.name: catch_incoming_weapon_or_ammunition
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can convert a fully-negated hit into catching the incoming ammunition or weapon, which requires an item-transfer/catch effect not present in the current atom inventory.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon

notes: The top-level fit is magic_item + triggered_reaction, using the existing hit_by_attack_roll trigger and reduce_damage_taken atom. No content file was authored because the primary reduction clause is not representable honestly without a generic ability-modifier addend.
